title: Gemini TTS — No More Fallback Voice
subtitle: Gemini voice is now strictly enforced — no Edge TTS, no browser speech, ever.
fixed: Server no longer falls back to Edge TTS when Gemini fails — returns a clean error instead
Frontend no longer falls back to browser SpeechSynthesis when Gemini TTS is unavailable
Reduced Gemini TTS timeout from 20s to 15s for faster error feedback

title: Gemini TTS Model Update
subtitle: Upgraded to Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS — studio-grade voice quality, no more Edge fallback.
fixed: Switched from gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts (access restricted) to gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview with gemini-3.8-flash-tts as upgrade path
Added dual-API support: legacy generateContent format + new Gemini Interactions API for 3.8 model
Gemini TTS no longer silently falls back to Edge when the model was inaccessible

title: Voice Reliability Fix
subtitle: Gemini TTS now plays correctly every time, and your voice choice sticks across characters.
fixed: Gemini TTS audio now plays — the API returns raw PCM which browsers can't decode; the server now wraps it in a WAV container automatically
Your selected voice and provider now persist when switching characters — no more reverting to Aoede on every new chat
TTS daily limit raised from 2,000 to 50,000 characters so it no longer silently falls back to Edge mid-session
Gemini TTS model name is now configurable via GEMINI_TTS_MODEL env var — model updates no longer need a code deploy
Fixed TTS button getting permanently stuck in 'playing' state when switching characters quickly

title: Cooldown Timer & Usage Reset Fix
subtitle: Session cooldown now shows a live countdown and resets correctly after 8 hours.
fixed: Cooldown timer now shows a live countdown (e.g. '7h 23m 41s remaining') instead of a clock time
Session cooldown now correctly resets after 8 hours — no more 24-hour wait
Usage bars (calls, memos, images) now show time remaining until the daily reset as a live countdown
Usage stats now properly clear when the cooldown expires, even without a new message

title: Images Load Instantly
subtitle: Character images now appear the moment the page loads, with no blank flash.
fixed: Character images now show immediately on page load — no more blank home page while loading
Loading spinner stays visible until all characters are ready, then the app appears fully populated

title: Voice Loading Indicator + TTS Reliability
subtitle: TTS button now shows a spinner while loading, and falls back to Edge TTS if Gemini is slow.
fixed: Voice button now shows a spinning animation while audio is loading — no more confusing silence
If Gemini voice takes longer than 6 seconds, automatically falls back to Edge TTS for instant response
Fixed TTS button getting stuck in loading state if audio failed to load

title: Pay with Credit Card
subtitle: Visa, Mastercard, Amex — now accepted directly at checkout alongside PayPal.
added: Credit card checkout — type your card number, expiry date, and CVV directly in the checkout modal
Payments are processed by Stripe — the same secure payment system used by Amazon, Google, and Shopify
PayPal and Credit Card tabs let you choose which method to use at checkout
3D Secure (bank verification popup) handled automatically when your bank requires it

title: Gemini Voice Fixed
subtitle: The natural human-sounding Gemini voice now actually works — the wrong model name was silently sending everyone to robot browser voice.
fixed: Gemini TTS was failing silently for every single request due to an incorrect API model name — the server was calling a model that doesn't exist, getting an error, and falling back to the robotic browser speech synthesis voice. Corrected to the real Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS model.

title: Coin Deduction Fix (Owner Account)
subtitle: Coins now correctly drain for the owner account even when it's listed in the test accounts env var.
fixed: Owner account coins were not subtracting after messages, images, or memos — this happened when the owner email was also in TEST_ACCOUNTS on the server; now the owner always drains coins regardless of TEST_ACCOUNTS

title: Gemini Voice is Now the Default
subtitle: New users and anyone without a saved voice preference now get the natural-sounding Gemini Aoede voice.
changed: Default TTS voice switched from Edge (robotic) to Gemini Aoede — the more human-sounding voice is now what everyone hears unless they've set a different preference

title: Removed ElevenLabs Voice Override
subtitle: Gemini and Edge voices are fully restored — ElevenLabs is no longer hijacking every call.
fixed: ElevenLabs TTS was overriding the voice for every user any time its API key was set on the server — completely ignoring the Gemini and Edge voice settings. ElevenLabs TTS has been removed from the voice pipeline; Gemini and Edge voices work as intended

title: Coin Deduction Enabled for Owner
subtitle: The owner account's coin balance now correctly drains on every chat, call, image, and memo.
fixed: Owner account was never having coins deducted — the unlimited-usage flag was accidentally blocking coin subtraction. Fixed: only test accounts skip coin deduction; the owner account drains coins normally

title: Checkout: Real Coin Dollar Discount
subtitle: Original price is now crossed out and your coin savings shown in dollars at checkout.
fixed: Checkout now shows the original plan price crossed out with a green effective price below it — your coin balance converts to a dollar discount and the total reflects what you actually owe
"You're saving $X.XX" message appears under the coin line so you see exactly what your coins are worth
If your coins cover the entire plan cost the total shows $0.00 with a confirmation message

title: Checkout: Coin Discount & Annual Savings
subtitle: Your coin balance now shows as a real dollar discount in the checkout summary.
changed: Checkout now shows your coin balance as a dollar discount — original price is crossed out and your effective total reflects the coin offset
Annual plans now show the crossed-out full-year price alongside the savings percentage in green
If your coins fully cover the plan cost, the total shows $0.00 with a confirmation message

title: Miss Delight: Full Lore & Personality
subtitle: Hundreds of new hover quotes and complete Poppy Playtime Chapter 3 lore.
changed: Miss Delight now has complete Poppy Playtime Chapter 3 canon — Playcare underground facility, August 8 1995 Hour of Joy, CatNap, The Prototype, all seven Smiling Critters, the seven Sister Teachers, Dr. Harley Sawyer, and her exact freeze-hunting gameplay behavior

Hover quotes expanded from 77 to 400+ lines — disturbing, psychotic, fake-encouraging, snarky, murderous, chaotic, and hilariously unhinged quotes that blend multiple moods at once for maximum unpredictability
Gambling number inputs — bet amount, auto-spin count, and coin exchange amounts are now type-in number fields instead of sliders and dropdowns

title: Coin Economy Overhaul & HD Voice
subtitle: Flat costs, subscription earn multipliers, and ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 voice.
changed: Coin costs are now flat fixed amounts — no more variable length-based pricing: chat costs 25 coins, calls 35, images 50, memos 20
Higher subscriptions now earn more from everything — daily check-in, missions, and game wins all multiply based on your tier (free 1×, Advanced 1.5×, X20 2×, X50 3×, X100 5×, X200 8×)
Daily check-in base reward raised from 10 to 50 coins; streak bonuses also significantly increased
Voices in calls upgraded to ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 — the most human-sounding model available

title: Voice Calls Fixed
subtitle: Seven bugs that caused complete call silence or broken mic recovery are gone.
fixed: Voice calls no longer go completely silent when the server TTS is unavailable — browser speech now takes over automatically
Starting a new call always resets the TTS state — no more getting stuck on silent mode from a previous call
Calls with browser TTS set in preferences now actually use browser speech instead of staying silent
TTS rate-limit (429) now correctly falls back to browser speech instead of silently hanging
Any server TTS failure during a call now falls back to browser speech for the current sentence
Mic permission error (not-allowed) now retries listening after 6 seconds instead of leaving the call stuck
Hanging up a call now correctly refreshes your usage and coin balance

title: Call Screen Redesign & Logo Cleanup
subtitle: Clean dark call screen with big (character.mind) brand text, sidebar logo back to normal.
changed: Call screen now uses a clean dark navy gradient instead of animated orbs
Character avatar shown as a circle at the top of the call screen
Large bold (character.mind) brand text shown center-screen during calls
Hang up button now labeled 'Hang up' instead of 'End'
Sidebar logo is back to plain character.mind without brackets

title: Control Panel Readability
subtitle: Owner control panel text is now bolder and easier to read.
changed: Control panel section headers, labels, inputs, and status text are now larger, bolder, and brighter — no more squinting at 11px dimmed labels

title: Coin Costs Tuned
subtitle: Calls only cost coins when the character actually speaks, and rates are lower so 6 calls fit in a daily budget.
changed: Voice calls no longer charge coins for time spent on the call — coins now only drain when the character responds
Chat and call response rates reduced so a normal day of coins supports up to ~6 calls
Image minimum coin cost lowered

title: Coin Economy: Pay Per Use
subtitle: C.M. Coins are now spent on every action — priced by response length, call duration, and image size.
added: Every AI response in chat now costs coins based on how long the reply is — longer responses cost more
Voice calls charge coins per second on the call, plus coins for each AI response during the call
Attaching an image costs coins based on the file size — larger images cost more
Coin balance updates immediately after each action — check the nav bar to see the impact

title: Call Screen & Logo Fixes
subtitle: Character no longer washes out during calls, logo centered with brackets.
fixed: Character image no longer washes out during voice calls — avatar is now rendered outside the orb blend layer so the screen-blend effect can't bleed into it
Custom characters' call screen orbs now cap brightness so they can't overpower the character image
CharacterMind branding on the call screen is now centered with bracket style
changed: Sidebar logo shows full [character.mind] with brackets, centered

title: Cooldowns Back & Logo Update
subtitle: 5-minute game cooldown is back, cooldown modal glitch fixed, and the logo now has brackets.
fixed: 5-minute cooldown between Hangman and Tic-Tac-Toe game sessions is restored — the usage panel now correctly shows the countdown
Fixed a glitch where the session-limit modal could close prematurely if a new cooldown started within 2 seconds of the previous one expiring
changed: Logo now shows as [c.m] with brackets in the sidebar — centered to match the Character.AI style

title: Daily Check-In Coin Fix
subtitle: Your coin count now updates immediately after the daily check-in reward.
fixed: Coin counter in the nav bar now updates right away after earning daily check-in coins — no more needing to refresh or open the usage panel to see the new balance

title: Edit & What's New Fixes
subtitle: Edited messages keep their line breaks, and the What's New dot no longer reappears after you've seen it.
fixed: Editing a user message now preserves line breaks — multiline messages no longer collapse to one line after saving an edit
What's New unread dot no longer reappears the next time you open the app after viewing What's New when the announcement list had just refreshed

title: Multiline Message Fix
subtitle: Shift+Enter now sends messages with proper line breaks.
fixed: Messages typed with Shift+Enter (multiple lines) now display with correct line breaks instead of running together on one line

title: Image Processing Fix
subtitle: Attaching images no longer causes a phantom page request.
fixed: Image cropping no longer triggers a silent browser page request when processing an attachment that has no source URL

title: Image History Fix
subtitle: Images in chat history now stay as images after the first save.
fixed: Image messages in history no longer turn into plain '📷 Image' text after the first session — they now correctly save and reload as image placeholders

title: Image Thumbnail Fix
subtitle: Attaching an image no longer silently re-requests the page.
fixed: Image preview thumbnail in the chat input bar now uses a safe empty placeholder — no more phantom page request every time you attach an image

title: Call & UI Bug Fixes
subtitle: Voice stops when you hang up, images show correctly, and the usage panel is back in order.
fixed: Voice no longer keeps playing after you end a call — browser speech is now properly stopped on hang-up
Call mode no longer falls back to robotic browser speech when the server voice is unavailable — it silently continues listening instead
Images sent in chat now show a 📷 placeholder in history instead of the text '[image]'
Image-only messages are no longer silently dropped from local chat history
Session Credits section moved to its natural place — below Activity, just above the Boost packs
Fixed a JavaScript error that fired on every mouse-leave event on the page

title: Admin Tools & Testing Improvements
subtitle: Easier account management and testing without burning your service coin budget.
added: Reset any user's limits by email — new 'Reset Limits' button in the admin panel
TEST_ACCOUNTS env var — emails listed there get unlimited usage so testing doesn't drain service coins

title: Voice Calls Always Work Now
subtitle: Browser speech fills in automatically when the server voice is unavailable.
fixed: Voice calls no longer go silent when the server TTS is unreachable — browser speech synthesis takes over automatically
CharacterMind logo now appears in the top-left corner of the call screen

title: Call Screen & Logo Fixes
subtitle: No more blinding yellow, and the logo is finally visible.
fixed: Call screen orb colors are now screen-safe — DogDay, KickinChicken and other bright characters no longer wash out to blinding white
CharacterMind sidebar logo is now a crisp SVG icon visible at any size — replaces the dark 1920×1080 image that was invisible at small sizes
Server no longer crashes on startup when VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY is not set — push notifications gracefully disabled instead

title: Reliability & Security Hardening
subtitle: A deep sweep of every route — unhandled errors are now caught, call interrupts no longer double-trigger, and the new-chat button can't be tapped twice.
fixed: Server errors on archive, sync, edit, check-in, and admin routes now return a proper response instead of leaving the connection hanging
Interrupting a call no longer triggers the listening loop twice
Tapping 'New Chat' quickly twice no longer starts two concurrent archives
Editing a message no longer marks the next unrelated message as '(edited)'
Missing DOM elements no longer crash the page on startup
VAPID private key fallback removed — server now fails fast if the env var is missing
Cron secret can no longer be leaked through request body logs
Admin email lookup is now properly case-insensitive

title: Bug Fixes & Polish
subtitle: A batch of reliability and accuracy fixes across the app.
fixed: Regenerate and Greet could silently leak a chat slot on server errors — now always released
Editing a message no longer accepts unlimited-length 'from' values
Exchange-rates endpoint now has a rate limit like other read endpoints
What's New entries with a missing section tag no longer break the modal
Call-limit reset countdown now shows the correct server-side reset time instead of a hardcoded 8-hour estimate
Voice-on badge during calls is properly cleaned up when the call ends early
Subtitles during calls now render at full speed to match the spoken audio
Playing two Hangman or Tic-Tac-Toe games at once no longer causes one to interfere with the other

title: Daily Grind, Missions & Fixes
subtitle: Coins every day, missions that animate, and a bunch of stuff that was broken.
added: Daily check-in — open the app each day to earn coins automatically (+10 base, streak bonuses at 3, 7, 14 and 30 days)
Mission swipe animation — claimed missions slide out and new ones slide in
Admin-configurable mission reward multiplier (0.1×–10×)
Session Credits toggle — turn token credit on/off from the Usage panel
fixed: Call screen orbs now render behind the character image instead of on top of it
Miss Delight (and all characters) can now see images — vision capability override added to system prompt
Image capability fix now also applies when regenerating a response
Call limit modal timer no longer shows "--:--:--" — always shows correct countdown to next reset
Staying signed in across deploys — server restarts no longer sign everyone out

title: Miss Delight has entered the Classroom
subtitle: She survived. She still thinks that makes her the good one.
added: Miss Delight — now available to chat with, voice calls included
Voice calls now work across all characters — powered by Edge TTS with browser fallback
Update emails now have structured sections: New Features, Bug Fixes, and Improvements
fixed: Miss Delight's call screen now shows her correct crimson and amber colors
First violence warning no longer incorrectly triggers an immediate account ban
Ban status screen could get stuck loading — now resolves correctly every time

title: DOEY has joined the Chat
subtitle: The Doughman is here — and he brought a patch.
added: DOEY the Doughman — now available to chat with
Hangman wins now award 5–20 coins based on word length, with a visible "+X coins!" popup
Hangman and Tic-Tac-Toe now survive page reloads — your game picks up right where you left off
Hangman words now range from 3 to 11+ letters with varying difficulty
Usage panel now warns you if you're on pace to hit your session limit early
Custom character creation — build and chat with your own characters
fixed: Hangman no longer shows wrong guesses as letters below the word
Coin display now updates correctly after a win even when the usage panel hasn't loaded yet
changed: 5-minute cooldown between games removed — play back-to-back
Free accounts now get ~7 messages per session (up from ~4)
Paid tiers now use exact token multipliers — X20 is a true 20× free, no rounding
